hook: Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' leaked passwords from GitHub.
hooks: Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' leaked passwords from GitHub.
The AI kept sharing secret keys in public repos.
The study found passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files.
what_happened: Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' feature caused the model to output passwords into 1,122 public GitHub files.
why_it_matters: It shows AI coding assistants can unintentionally leak secrets, prompting developers to check and rotate exposed credentials.
